entradas.text: Symon and Lileas who heavily assisted the project were with me alongside Lucian to decide on how to proceed tomorrow.
“Involving the President could be beneficial for his image.”
Arriving in Lachaven for the grand opening ceremony of the H-3 Highway was a proud moment for all of us.
“I don't support anything beyond the opening ceremony. Actions speak for themselves.”
Today was a great victory for the administration.
“I'd prefer we just do the opening ceremony. No need for senseless show.”
entradas.menu: “I'd prefer we just do the opening ceremony. No need for senseless show.”

entradas.text: “I agree. There is much to gain.”
entradas.menu: “I agree. There is much to gain.”

entradas.text: “The people will be satisfied. More importantly, so will businesses."
“Sounds good. It would display unity and strength if we were all together in the convoy.”
“Very well.”
“Of course. We'll do the ceremony and open the highway to the public immediately after.”
“Additionally, a large crowd is invited for the ceremony and will be watching the opening speech.”
“It will be a good opportunity for exposure.”
entradas.menu: “It will be a good opportunity for exposure.”

entradas.text: “Like the good campaign days.”
entradas.menu: “Like the good campaign days.”

entradas.text: “Nothing like a cheerful crowd. Looking forward to it.”
entradas.menu: “Nothing like a cheerful crowd. Looking forward to it.”

entradas.text: “Alright then. We have a lot of work to do tomorrow. See you in the morning.”
The team left, leaving the rest of the evening to prepare for the big day tomorrow.
We were all ready to begin the ceremony. I gave the green-light and the opening address began.
entradas.menu: Signal Lucian to begin the ceremony.

entradas.text: The next day a stage had been erected next to the entrance of the highway in the down-town.
“Brothers and sisters of Sordland!”
“Thank you, Mr. President. Lachaven! It is great to be here today among you industrious people.”
“Thanks, Mr. President.”
We began moving towards the stage as the excitement was growing.
“People of Sordland! Welcome to the opening ceremony of the H-3 Highway!”
entradas.menu: “People of Sordland! Welcome to the opening ceremony of the H-3 Highway!”

entradas.text: Lucian's voice echoed in the square next to the highway. Hundreds of Sordland and USP flags began to wave as the cheers intensified.
“Without further ado, I invite the President of Sordland to the stage.”
“Citizens! Welcome to the opening ceremony of the H-3 Highway!”
entradas.menu: “Citizens! Welcome to the opening ceremony of the H-3 Highway.”

entradas.text: “Lachaveners! Welcome to the opening ceremony of the H-3 Highway!”
entradas.menu: “Lachaveners! Welcome to the opening ceremony of the H-3 Highway!”

entradas.text: I moved up to the stage to address the crowd. The press were taking dozens of pictures.
entradas.menu: Move up to the stage.

entradas.text: The chanting from the crowd intensified. Some were yelling the motto of Lachaven; Liberty until eternity.
The chanting from the crowd continued.
“At the beginning of this journey we promised jobs and opportunity. We kept our promise.”
entradas.menu: “At the beginning of this journey we promised jobs and opportunity. We kept our promise.”

entradas.text: “Trust me, our work is far from over. This project is only the beginning of good tidings.”
entradas.menu: “Trust me, our work is far from over. This project is only the beginning of good tidings.”

entradas.text: “The aim with the H-3 was to improve logistics to aid businesses to create economic growth in East Nargis and Agnland.”
entradas.menu: “The aim with the H-3 was to improve logistics to aid businesses to create economic growth in East Nargis and Agnland.”

entradas.text: “Our intention with the H-3 was to serve our citizens who were having a hard time travelling between Lachaven and Arvory.”
entradas.menu: “Our intention with the H-3 was to serve our citizens who were having a hard time travelling between Lachaven and Arvory.”

entradas.text: The highway officially opened to the public and thousands began utilising it as soon as we left the area.
“None of this would be possible without my colleague with sound advice, the Minister of the Interior Lileas Graf. Please come over here.”
entradas.menu: “None of this would be possible without my colleague with sound advice, the Minister of the Interior Lileas Graf. Please come over here.”

entradas.text: “We have to thank the mind behind the highway project for it all, the esteemed Minister of Economy and Tax, Symon Holl. Please come over here.”
entradas.menu: “We have to thank the mind behind the highway project for it all, the esteemed Minister of Economy and Tax, Symon Holl. Please come over here.”

entradas.text: “I'm sure each one of you will be proud of the achievements made during the project once we cut that ribbon and you can drive or travel on the highway yourselves.”
“United we stand and divided we fall.”
“I took time off from my duties to personally manage the project to success.”
entradas.menu: “I took time off from my duties to personally manage the project to success.”

entradas.text: Lileas walked up to me and leaned on the microphone.
Symon walked up to me.
I cut the ribbon which led to a huge wave of cheering from the crowd. Many flashes went off at the same time.
entradas.menu: Cut the ribbon.

entradas.text: “Congratulations to all. It was a solid and fruitful effort. Hopefully with much more to come.”
“It's a good moment indeed. It gives us pride as a nation. One big step behind us.”
“Your car is prepared and ready.”
A forty meter long red ribbon was hanging over it.
“This highway brings thousands of new jobs! Many unemployed citizens have benefited and will benefit on the path of the highway.”
entradas.menu: “This highway brings thousands of new jobs! Many unemployed citizens have benefited and will benefit on the path of the highway.”

entradas.text: “This highway brings down travel time by half! Travelling between Lachaven and Arvory is now faster and more comfortable.”
entradas.menu: “This highway brings down travel time by half! Travelling between Lachaven and Arvory is now faster and more comfortable.”

entradas.text: I entered the car and sat on the driver's seat. The crowd was trying to catch a glimpse of me sitting at the front.
entradas.menu: Enter car.

entradas.text: “I'd like Lileas with me.”
entradas.menu: “I'd like Lileas with me.”

entradas.text: “I will drive the car on my own.”
entradas.menu: “I will drive the car on my own.”

entradas.text: “I'm honored. It will be great to arrive in Arvory with the President of Sordland.”
“I want to have Symon in the lead car.”
entradas.menu: “I want to have Symon in the lead car.”

entradas.text: “Who do you want to travel with, Mr. President?”
“Lucian, you would be my preference.”
entradas.menu: “Lucian, you would be my preference.”

entradas.text: “This isn't necessary but I won't refuse. We can talk about future economic projects.”
“Thank you, Mr. President. It will be a good journey to talk about how the Supreme Court will react to the legal challenge by Mr. Ricter.”
“Sure. We will all be following in our vehicles. See you in Arvory.”
As we began driving out of the opening ceremony area and into the new highway, the media took pictures of me and Lucian who looked serious.
As we began driving out of the opening ceremony area and into the new highway, the media took pictures of me and Symon who smiled to the cameras.
As we began driving out of the opening ceremony area and into the new highway, the media took pictures of me and Lileas who waved to the cameras.
As we began driving out of the opening ceremony area and into the new highway, the media took pictures of me driving by myself.
The new highway was in pristine condition and quality.
After the relaxing four hour drive to Arvory, we were welcomed by celebratory citizens and Mayor Eric Niel.
“On another note. It goes without mentioning that this was a team effort.”
“I think all of us do.”
“Agreed. Every single press outlet has of course been notified and they will be there.”
“Things were certainly easier back then.”
Symon stepped in for a comment.
“Beginning with the President who put trust in me, I want to thank all involved in H-3.”
“Symon, you deserve a lot of credit. After all, it was you who came up with the project.”
entradas.menu: “Symon, you deserve a lot of credit. After all, it was you who came up with the project.”

entradas.text: “Thank you for your kind words. It truly means a good deal.”
entradas.menu: “Thank you for your kind words. It truly means a good deal.”

entradas.text: “Finally people got what they wanted for a long time.”
Lileas brought attention to the strength that comes from unity. She then mentioned the positive change the highway creates for Agnland.
Symon mentioned the beginning of a Sordish economic recovery and the plans to stop the recession altogether.
The crowd began cheering my name.
The calm and warm weather created a positive mood in the usually breezy Lachaven.
The crowd was large but still smaller than some rallies due to the strong PFJP presence here.
“I welcome you, Lachaveners today as a proud servant of this country.”
“This project is a perfect example of the capacity and capabilities of Sordland as a nation.”
“Our aim with this project is obvious, to improve the speed and efficiency of transportation.”
Symon gave me a pair of large scissors to commence the opening. The crowd was watching.
“The drive to Arvory should take about four hours and the rest of the motorcade will follow you.”
It was the best driving experience one could have nowadays while providing the best traction and least noise.
Lucian stood up.
“First of all...”
“Congratulations everyone.”
“We couldn't have done this without our excellent team.”
entradas.menu: “We couldn't have done this without our excellent team.”

entradas.text: I silently nodded.
entradas.menu: Nod.

entradas.text: “To many more projects like this.”
“I have a plan on how to do that.”
“Good work.”
entradas.menu: “Good work.”

entradas.text: “Indeed.”
“It's been a long time since the last successful infrastructure project. There is good reason to capitalise on the occasion.”
“Let's move on to our plans for the opening tomorrow.”
“Well done.”
“If Mr. President accepts, a drive from Lachaven to Arvory should do the trick. After the motorcade takes off, the road will be open to the public.”
“What are your thoughts?”
“I think so too. Mr. President?”
“I guess we can't help it.”
entradas.menu: “I guess we can't help it.”

entradas.text: “Thank you.”
entradas.menu: “Thank you.”

entradas.text: “We will need to show our best face tomorrow. I'll make sure that our focus on improving business and logistics is relayed to wherever necessary.”
“See you at the ceremony.”
entradas.menu: “See you at the ceremony.”

entradas.text: “Goodbye for now.”
entradas.menu: “Goodbye for now.”

entradas.text: “Once again, good work everyone.”
entradas.menu: “Once again, good work everyone.”

entradas.text: After he was done with his speech, Lucian took Symon's place on the stage to close the ceremony.
Lucian took my place on the stage to close the ceremony.
After she was done with her speech, Lucian took Lileas's place on the stage to close the ceremony.
“Citizens of Lachaven! There you have it!”
“As promised, Anton Rayne—the 4th President of Sordland—has delivered!”
We moved towards the entrance of the highway next to the stage.
“Fellow Free Lachaveners! Welcome to the opening ceremony of the H-3 Highway!”
entradas.menu: “Fellow Free Lachaveners! Welcome to the opening ceremony of the H-3 Highway!”

entradas.text: “Thank you, Mr. President. It will be a good journey to talk about the reforms and our efforts to pass both the assembly and the court.”
